datasets.name: ctr_kpi
queryLines: WITH c AS (SELECT * FROM quebec.gold.vw_ctr_contratos c WHERE vigente AND (:filial = 'Todas' OR filial = :filial) AND (:centro_custo = 'Todos' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM quebec.gold.vw_ctr_medicoes cm WHERE cm.cod_filial = c.cod_filial AND cm.contrato = c.contrato AND cm.centro_custo = :centro_custo)) AND (c.dt_inicio IS NULL OR c.dt_inicio <= :data_fim) AND (c.dt_fim IS NULL OR c.dt_fim >= :data_inicio)), r AS (SELECT * FROM quebec.gold.vw_ctr_revisoes_feitas c WHERE (:filial = 'Todas' OR filial = :filial) AND (:centro_custo = 'Todos' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM quebec.gold.vw_ctr_medicoes cm WHERE cm.cod_filial = c.cod_filial AND cm.contrato = c.contrato AND cm.centro_custo = :centro_custo)) AND c.dt_revisao BETWEEN :data_inicio AND :data_fim), m AS (SELECT * FROM quebec.gold.vw_ctr_medicoes WHERE (:filial = 'Todas' OR filial = :filial) AND (:centro_custo = 'Todos' OR centro_custo = :centro_custo) AND dt_entrega BETWEEN :data_inicio AND :data_fim) SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM c) AS contratos_vigentes, (SELECT sum(vl_atual) FROM c) AS valor_contratado, (SELECT sum(saldo) FROM c) AS saldo_a_medir, (SELECT try_divide(sum(vl_atual - saldo), sum(vl_atual)) FROM c) AS pct_consumido, (SELECT sum(crescimento) FROM c) AS crescimento_valor, (SELECT try_divide(sum(crescimento), sum(vl_original)) FROM c) AS pct_crescimento, (SELECT count(alerta) FROM c) AS contratos_em_alerta, (SELECT count(DISTINCT cod_filial, contrato) FROM r) AS revisados_periodo, (SELECT coalesce(sum(impacto), 0) FROM r) AS impacto_revisoes_periodo, (SELECT sum(valor) FROM m) AS medido_periodo, (SELECT try_divide(sum(valor), greatest(1, months_between(date_trunc('MONTH', least(:data_fim, current_date())), date_trunc('MONTH', :data_inicio)) + 1)) FROM m) AS media_mensal_periodo, (SELECT count(DISTINCT cod_filial, contrato) FROM m) AS contratos_com_medicao

datasets.name: ctr_mes
queryLines: WITH m AS ( SELECT mes, sum(valor) AS valor, count(DISTINCT cod_filial, contrato, medicao) AS medicoes, count(DISTINCT cod_filial, contrato) AS contratos FROM quebec.gold.vw_ctr_medicoes WHERE (:filial = 'Todas' OR filial = :filial) AND (:centro_custo = 'Todos' OR centro_custo = :centro_custo) AND mes IS NOT NULL GROUP BY mes), mm AS (SELECT *, avg(valor) OVER (ORDER BY mes ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS media_movel_3m FROM m) SELECT * FROM mm WHERE mes BETWEEN date_trunc('MONTH', :data_inicio) AND :data_fim ORDER BY mes

datasets.name: ctr_rev_tipo
datasets.displayName: Contratos - impacto por tipo de revisão
queryLines: SELECT tipo_revisao, count(*) AS revisoes, count(DISTINCT cod_filial, contrato) AS contratos, sum(impacto) AS impacto FROM quebec.gold.vw_ctr_revisoes_feitas c WHERE (:filial = 'Todas' OR filial = :filial) AND (:centro_custo = 'Todos' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM quebec.gold.vw_ctr_medicoes cm WHERE cm.cod_filial = c.cod_filial AND cm.contrato = c.contrato AND cm.centro_custo = :centro_custo)) AND c.dt_revisao BETWEEN :data_inicio AND :data_fim GROUP BY tipo_revisao ORDER BY impacto DESC

datasets.name: ctr_forn
queryLines: WITH f AS (SELECT fornecedor, sum(valor) AS valor, count(DISTINCT cod_filial, contrato) AS contratos FROM quebec.gold.vw_ctr_medicoes WHERE (:filial = 'Todas' OR filial = :filial) AND (:centro_custo = 'Todos' OR centro_custo = :centro_custo) AND dt_entrega BETWEEN :data_inicio AND :data_fim GROUP BY fornecedor), r AS (SELECT *, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY valor DESC) AS ranking, try_divide(valor, sum(valor) OVER ()) AS pct, try_divide(sum(valor) OVER (ORDER BY valor DESC ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING), sum(valor) OVER ()) AS pct_acumulado FROM f) SELECT *, CASE WHEN pct_acumulado <= 0.8 THEN 'A' WHEN pct_acumulado <= 0.95 THEN 'B' ELSE 'C' END AS classe FROM r WHERE ranking <= 15 ORDER BY ranking

datasets.name: ctr_cc
queryLines: SELECT centro_custo, sum(valor) AS valor, count(DISTINCT cod_filial, contrato) AS contratos FROM quebec.gold.vw_ctr_medicoes WHERE (:filial = 'Todas' OR filial = :filial) AND (:centro_custo = 'Todos' OR centro_custo = :centro_custo) AND dt_entrega BETWEEN :data_inicio AND :data_fim GROUP BY centro_custo ORDER BY valor DESC LIMIT 15

datasets.name: ctr_proj
queryLines: SELECT projeto, sum(valor) AS valor, count(DISTINCT cod_filial, contrato) AS contratos FROM quebec.gold.vw_ctr_medicoes WHERE (:filial = 'Todas' OR filial = :filial) AND (:centro_custo = 'Todos' OR centro_custo = :centro_custo) AND dt_entrega BETWEEN :data_inicio AND :data_fim GROUP BY projeto ORDER BY valor DESC LIMIT 15

datasets.name: ctr_alertas
queryLines: SELECT filial, contrato, fornecedor, tipo_contrato, alerta, dt_fim, dias_para_vencer, vl_original, vl_atual, saldo, pct_consumido, pct_crescimento FROM quebec.gold.vw_ctr_contratos c WHERE alerta IS NOT NULL AND (:filial = 'Todas' OR filial = :filial) AND (:centro_custo = 'Todos' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM quebec.gold.vw_ctr_medicoes cm WHERE cm.cod_filial = c.cod_filial AND cm.contrato = c.contrato AND cm.centro_custo = :centro_custo)) ORDER BY alerta, saldo

datasets.name: ctr_rev_periodo
queryLines: SELECT filial, contrato, revisao, dt_revisao, tipo_revisao, fornecedor, vl_atual, impacto FROM quebec.gold.vw_ctr_revisoes_feitas c WHERE (:filial = 'Todas' OR filial = :filial) AND (:centro_custo = 'Todos' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM quebec.gold.vw_ctr_medicoes cm WHERE cm.cod_filial = c.cod_filial AND cm.contrato = c.contrato AND cm.centro_custo = :centro_custo)) AND c.dt_revisao BETWEEN :data_inicio AND :data_fim ORDER BY dt_revisao DESC

datasets.name: ctr_vig
queryLines: SELECT * FROM quebec.gold.vw_ctr_contratos c WHERE vigente AND (:filial = 'Todas' OR filial = :filial) AND (:centro_custo = 'Todos' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM quebec.gold.vw_ctr_medicoes cm WHERE cm.cod_filial = c.cod_filial AND cm.contrato = c.contrato AND cm.centro_custo = :centro_custo)) AND (c.dt_inicio IS NULL OR c.dt_inicio <= :data_fim) AND (c.dt_fim IS NULL OR c.dt_fim >= :data_inicio) ORDER BY vl_atual DESC

datasets.name: ctr_ccs
queryLines: SELECT centro_custo FROM (SELECT 'Todos' AS centro_custo UNION SELECT centro_custo FROM quebec.gold.vw_ctr_medicoes) WHERE centro_custo IS NOT NULL ORDER BY CASE WHEN centro_custo = 'Todos' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, centro_custo

datasets.name: filiais
queryLines: SELECT filial FROM (SELECT 'Todas' AS filial UNION SELECT filial FROM quebec.gold.vw_ctr_contratos UNION SELECT filial FROM quebec.gold.vw_ctr_revisoes_feitas UNION SELECT filial FROM quebec.gold.vw_ctr_medicoes) WHERE filial IS NOT NULL ORDER BY CASE WHEN filial = 'Todas' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, filial

lines: ## Contratos de compra: custo contratado, consumido e crescimento

**Contratado × consumido:** contratos vigentes cuja vigência cruza o período, e quanto já foi medido. **Crescimento:** quanto o valor atual passou do valor original (aditivos e reajustes); é custo que não estava no orçamento inicial.

**Filtros:** o período vale para medições (data de entrega), revisões (data da revisão) e vigência dos contratos. O centro de custo vem dos itens medidos: um contrato entra no CC quando tem medição nele. Os alertas são a situação de hoje e não seguem o período.
